description: 外部验证 live proof gate 契约。该 gate 消费 closure work queue、proof-ref gate、category runbooks 和可选 operator 脱敏 live evidence bundle，校验真实 live 执行摘要与 work item、proof-ref、category runbook、当前 commit 和 source occurrence 的绑定；无 live evidence 时保持 pending/blocked，不连接真实外部系统，不把 proof-ref 结构通过等同于 category live 通过。

closurePolicy.proofRefDependency: live proof can only be accepted when the referenced proofRef was already schema-accepted for the same work item.
closurePolicy.runbookDependency: live proof must bind to the category runbook id for the same category.
closurePolicy.shipGate: Even when all work items have accepted live proof, shipGate remains blocked until third-party audit and certification review consume the evidence.
closurePolicy.nonClosure: This gate validates redacted live evidence summaries; it does not execute production checks itself and does not verify hidden secret material.

privacyBoundary: Live proof gate 只保存脱敏 proof id、owner、category、workItemId、runbookId、liveGateKind、artifact hash、source binding 和命令 hash；不得保存真实 URL、token、secret、DSN、私钥、生产日志、trace payload、报告正文、用户输入或外部账号数据。
nonClaims: Does not prove hidden external artifacts are authentic without operator and audit review.
Does not authorize production credential use.
Does not mean FateCat is 100% production infrastructure.
